# All Fluence Trading (AFT)

> All Fluence Trading sells educational software and training for futures traders: two instrument-specific TradingView indicators (the MNQ Master Trader for Micro Nasdaq and the MGC Master Trader for Micro Gold), a general structure-and-levels overlay (The All Fluence indicator), a recorded course, and a premium Discord where shogotrades trades the method live. Membership is sold on Whop. It is not a signals service and makes no performance promises.

## Facts
- Site: https://allfluencetrading.com/ (landing page), https://allfluencetrading.com/challenge/ (the free AFT Challenge paper-trading program)
- Instruments: MNQ and MGC futures (CME micros); charts apply equally to NQ and GC.
- Platform: TradingView. Indicators are invite-only scripts added to the member's TradingView username. A free TradingView account is sufficient.
- Timezone used throughout: America/New_York. Daily VWAP is anchored at the CME 18:00 ET open.
- Membership price (as listed on Whop, Nov 2026): a 3-month term paid as three monthly payments of USD 100 (or USD 300 up front), or USD 1,000 per year; 14-day free trial; 7-day money-back on the first charge.
- Checkout and reviews: https://whop.com/aft-official/ (5.0 from 11 reviews, 76 members as of 2026-11-04).
- Community: Discord (invite on the site), YouTube/TikTok/Twitch @shogotrades.
- Contact: support@allfluencetrading.com
- Course: eleven chapters (market structure, higher-timeframe bias, imbalances, ICC and 2H/4H levels, opening ranges, VWAP, entry models, relative strength, sizing, news days, trade breakdowns), all open during the 14-day free trial.
- Proof on the site: member-posted prop-firm payouts, P&L and testimonials from the AFT Discord (sections "Payouts", "Profit & loss", "In their words"), each shown as posted with a disclaimer; and the MNQ Book / MGC Book Strategy Tester figures for the last 365 days (hypothetical; the Books differ from the indicators by an estimated 1–5% of trades).
- Method in one line: higher-timeframe bias from imbalances, entries on pullbacks into a confluence stack (imbalance midline, 2H/4H structure level, VWAP band, opening range, session open), resting limit orders with structural stops, targets at structure.

## Compliance
- Educational tools only; not investment advice; futures trading involves substantial risk of loss.
- No automated execution is sold; automated strategies are released to members only after passing testing.
